spans.s:
आढक आढक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (etym. doubt-
ful), a measure of grain, the 4th of a droṇa and equal
to 4 prasthas = 16 kuḍavas = 64 palas = 256 karṣas =
4096 māṣas; or containing nearly 7 lbs. 11 ozs. avoir-
dupois. In Bengal an आढक is equal to two mans or
164 lbs. avds.; (ई), f. a kind of pulse, Cajanus Indicus
Spreng.; a kind of fragrant earth.
—आढक-जम्बु,
N. of a country.
—आढकजम्बुक, अस्, ई, अम्,
relating to that country.

आढकिक, अस्, ई, अम्, or आढकीन, अस्, आ, अम्,
holding or containing an āḍhaka; sown with an
āḍhaka of seed, as a field &c.
